mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (at or below 0.25%) indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS <= 0.25%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 7.0% signals a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 7.0%, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals robust consumer demand and economic expansion, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through improved corporate revenue outlook.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS increase, or the interaction term's Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In the zero lower bound monetary policy regime (FEDFUNDS <= 0.25%), a decline in the unemployment rate signals a strengthening labor market that increases confidence in economic recovery, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS <= 0.25% and UNRATE declines, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in industrial production above 99.5 (index 2017=100) signals a strengthening manufacturing sector that boosts corporate profits and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 99.5, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained high level of housing starts (HOUST above 1000 thousand units) indicates strong residential construction activity that supports consumer confidence and corporate investment, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 1000, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of strong job growth (PAYEMS above 135000 thousand persons) and a low unemployment rate (UNRATE below 7.5%) signals a robust labor market that increases disposable income and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS > 135000 and UNRATE < 7.5, or the interaction term's Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in industrial production above 99.0 (index 2017=100) signals a near-term acceleration in manufacturing output that increases corporate earnings expectations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 99.0, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.
